categories.main_business_segments: Haseko Corporation operates four main business segments: Construction-related (planning, design, and construction of condominiums and buildings), Real Estate-related (condominium sales and leasing), Service-related (large-scale condominium repairs, property management, leasing management, brokerage, and senior care services), and Overseas-related (real estate development and commercial facility operations in the United States).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes integrated construction management, proprietary BIM (Building Information Modeling) systems, industrialized and ICT-driven construction methods, and environmentally conscious materials such as H-BA concrete. It also focuses on digital transformation (DX), automation, and the development of wood-based and hybrid construction technologies, as well as advanced renovation and maintenance techniques for existing housing stock.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Haseko primarily serves real estate developers, condominium buyers, property owners, and residents in urban areas, especially in the Tokyo metropolitan, Kinki, and Tokai regions. Its end markets include residential condominium buyers, rental property investors, and senior citizens requiring care services, as well as commercial clients in the U.S. for overseas operations.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s core operations are concentrated in Japan, particularly in the Tokyo metropolitan, Kinki, and Tokai regions, with additional activities in major urban centers nationwide. Overseas, it operates mainly in the United States, especially Hawaii and California, through subsidiaries and joint ventures.
categories.supply_chain_position: Haseko operates primarily as a midstream and downstream player in the supply chain, handling project planning, design, construction, sales, leasing, and property management. It also sources materials and coordinates with upstream suppliers and subcontractors, while providing end-to-end solutions for residential and commercial real estate.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the construction and management business, expanding real estate and service offerings, and growing overseas operations to diversify revenue streams. R&D focuses on sustainability (decarbonization, renewable energy, eco-friendly materials), digital transformation (BIM, AI, data platforms), productivity improvements, and the development of new business domains such as wood-based construction and social issue-driven businesses.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through construction contracts, real estate sales (primarily condominiums and houses), property leasing, property management fees, large-scale repair and renovation services, brokerage commissions, and senior care service fees. Overseas, revenue comes from real estate development, sales, and commercial facility operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haseko is a leading player in the Japanese condominium construction and management market, often regarded as a top specialist in large-scale residential projects. Its main competitors include major general contractors (such as Obayashi, Shimizu, and Taisei), real estate developers, and property management firms. Haseko differentiates itself through its integrated value chain and strong market share in condominium construction.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales reached approximately 1.18 trillion yen, with recurring profit of 83.4 billion yen and net income attributable to parent company shareholders of 34.5 billion yen. The company employs over 8,300 people and has shown steady sales growth, though recent profit margins have been pressured by rising costs and special losses. The medium-term plan targets recurring profit of 100 billion yen by FY2028 and 130 billion yen by FY2031.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haseko’s value proposition lies in its integrated, end-to-end solutions for urban residential environments, combining planning, construction, sales, management, and after-sales services. The company emphasizes high construction quality, on-time delivery, advanced technology adoption (BIM, DX), sustainability (eco-friendly materials, decarbonization), and comprehensive support for residents’ lifestyles, including senior care. Its strong brand and expertise in large-scale condominium projects set it apart from competitors.
